title: Quantum Grover Adaptive Search for Discrete Simulation Optimization
summary: Quantum computing has advanced rapidly in recent years and has shown advantages in a variety of domains. In this paper, we investigate its potential for discrete simulation optimization in the fixed-confidence setting, a fundamental problem in the simulation literature. We first introduce a quantum simulation oracle that prepares a coherent superposition over all candidate solutions and provides the foundation for quantum algorithm design.
